description: Read the bin id off the single ERROR line a grain store's blower house raised during an evening of drying. DISTILL-CANARY-b04d957d

files.README.md:
# Gowdall Grain - blower house journal

One line per blower state change or duct check. ERROR lines name the bin that
raised them and the fault code; ordinary lines are INFO.
